description: This file defines a Java class 'Tokenizer' that provides tokenization functionality for strings, supporting delimiters of multiple characters, with options for trimming tokens and handling complex delimiters via regex.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A string tokenizer class that accepts multi-character delimiters and provides tokenization with optional trimming.

classes.name: StringTokenizerIterator
classes.description: An inner class implementing an iterator over tokens produced by Java's StringTokenizer, supporting trimming and iteration.

methods.name: Tokenizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tokenizer with a list of delimiters, setting up regex pattern if delimiters are multi-character.

methods.name: isTrimTokens
methods.description: Returns whether tokens are trimmed during tokenization.

methods.name: setTrimTokens
methods.description: Sets whether tokens should be trimmed.

methods.name: onlyOneChar
methods.description: Checks if all delimiters are single-character strings.

methods.name: delimitersToRegexp
methods.description: Converts a list of delimiters into a regex pattern for tokenization.

methods.name: addToTokens
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is not empty after optional trimming.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on the configured delimiters or pattern, returning an iterator.
